title: Irvine & Orange County: Sun, Culture & Coastal Bliss: A week in Southern California's most livable city — from world-class parks to Pacific sunsets
description: Irvine sits at the heart of Orange County, blending master-planned green spaces with an incredible international dining scene, easy beach access, and outdoor adventures. This 7-day itinerary takes your group from the Great Park balloon ride to Crystal Cove tide pools, through Irvine's legendary Asian food corridor, and out to the coastal villages of Laguna and Newport.

days.title: Arrival & The Great Park
days.description: Settle in, then explore Irvine's crown jewel — the 1,300-acre Great Park built on the former El Toro Marine base.

activities.name: Orange County Great Park
activities.description: Start with the iconic Great Park Balloon — a tethered helium balloon that rises 400 feet for panoramic views of the Santa Ana Mountains and the Pacific. Then explore the farm, playground, and art galleries.

days.title: Food Crawl & University Culture
days.description: Dive into Irvine's legendary Asian food scene, then explore the UCI campus and its world-class art museum.

activities.name: Diamond Jamboree Food Crawl
activities.description: This open-air plaza is ground zero for Irvine's food scene. Walk between a dozen incredible Asian restaurants — from hand-pulled noodles to Korean fried chicken.

activities.name: UCI Campus & Langson IMCA
activities.description: Stroll the beautiful UC Irvine campus — the Aldrich Park ring road is a peaceful walk through eucalyptus groves. Visit the Jack and Shanaz Langson Institute and Museum of California Art (IMCA) for rotating contemporary exhibitions.

days.neighborhoods: Crystal Cove · Newport Coast · Laguna Beach
days.title: Coastal Day — Crystal Cove to Laguna
days.description: Head to the coast for tide pools, a historic beach village, and the art galleries of Laguna Beach.

activities.name: Crystal Cove State Park
activities.description: This 3.2-mile stretch of coastline is one of the last undeveloped spots on the Orange County coast. Explore tide pools at low tide, hike the bluffs, or just beachcomb.

activities.name: Laguna Beach Art Walk
activities.description: Drive down PCH to Laguna Beach and wander the downtown gallery district. Over 100 galleries line the streets — from fine art to surf photography.

days.neighborhoods: Bommer Canyon · Turtle Rock · Irvine Spectrum
days.title: Hiking & Shopping
days.description: Hit the trails in the morning, then spend the afternoon at one of SoCal's best outdoor shopping destinations.

activities.name: Bommer Canyon Trail
activities.description: A moderate 4.5-mile loop through coastal sage scrub with views of the valley. You might spot coyotes, hawks, or even a bobcat.

activities.name: Irvine Spectrum Center
activities.description: More than a mall — this 93-acre outdoor center has a giant Ferris wheel, IMAX theater, and over 150 shops and restaurants under the signature Moorish-inspired architecture.

days.neighborhoods: Newport Beach · Balboa Island · Corona del Mar
days.title: Newport Beach Day
days.description: Explore the classic OC beach town — from the Balboa Peninsula boardwalk to the charming shops of Balboa Island.

activities.name: Balboa Island & Ferry
activities.description: Take the tiny Balboa Island Ferry ($1.50/person) across the harbor. Walk the perimeter path with bay views, then hit Marine Avenue for the famous Balboa Bar — a frozen banana dipped in chocolate.

activities.name: Newport Beach Pier & Boardwalk
activities.description: Walk the historic pier for ocean views, then stroll the Balboa Peninsula boardwalk. In winter the surf can be dramatic — great for watching from the pier.

activities.name: Corona del Mar State Beach
activities.description: This quieter, upscale beach has tide pools at Little Corona and calm swimming coves. The viewpoints along Ocean Blvd are postcard-perfect.

days.title: Day Trip — Mission & Harbor
days.description: Head south to the historic Mission San Juan Capistrano and the laid-back Dana Point Harbor for whale watching season.

activities.name: Mission San Juan Capistrano
activities.description: Founded in 1776, this is one of California's most beautiful missions. The gardens, ruins of the Great Stone Church, and the Serra Chapel (oldest building in California still in use) are stunning.

activities.name: Dana Point Whale Watching
activities.description: February is peak whale watching season! Gray whales migrate past Dana Point, and blue whales sometimes appear. Captain Dave's Dolphin & Whale Safari runs 2-hour tours.

days.title: Last Day — Local Favorites
days.description: Wrap up the trip with a gentle morning hike, one more incredible meal, and some last-minute exploring.

activities.name: Quail Hill Loop Trail
activities.description: An easy 2-mile loop with sweeping views of Irvine, Saddleback Mountain, and the Pacific on clear days. Perfect sunrise or morning walk.

activities.name: Last Boba & Souvenirs
activities.description: Make a final stop at Culver Plaza for one more boba run and any souvenir shopping. 99 Ranch Market is nearby if you want to take home Asian snacks and treats.
